Spiced Hot Chocolate
By: Danielle
Published: Sunday, October 3, 2010 - 10:35pm

Ingredients




2 cups 2%% Milk
2 Cinnamon sticks
3 tablespoons cocoa powder
3 tablespoons granulated sugar
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
of cayenne pepper

Preparation

1 Warm milk over medium heat and add cinnamon sticks.  Once milk is warm, add cocoa powder, sugar, vanilla and cayenne pepper, stir until cocoa powder and sugar are dissolved. Remove from heat and pour into mug.  Serve as is, or topped whipped cream or marshmallows.  Enjoy!
